rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Prevent customer-facing model instructions from reducing trust, click-through, and conversion.
rules.laggingMetric: qualified leads and attributed gross profit per distributed post
guardrails: Do not block legitimate customer-facing copy that mentions AI.
Do not weaken release QA or authoritative Buffer readback.
rules.control: Block posting-pack and Buffer queue generation when outbound social-copy fields contain model meta-instructions.
rules.rollbackCondition: False-positive rate exceeds 5% of reviewed social-copy files.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Decision-oriented and monetary-history silver reels may attract more high-intent Fused Reserve attention than broad industrial or outlook topics, creating more opportunities for qualified site visits and later conversions.
rules.leadingMetric: Matched YouTube D+3 and D+7 views per hour, followed by engagement rate
rules.laggingMetric: Attributed Fused Reserve clicks, qualified leads, conversions, and gross profit
guardrails: Do not claim causality from the initial five-post sample.
Do not compare posts at different age buckets or use lifetime totals.
Do not reduce research accuracy, financial disclaimers, or the separate tech publishing cadence.
rules.control: For the next three comparable silver publishing days, include one accurate decision-oriented, selling, or monetary-history reel and measure it at D+3 and D+7 against industrial/outlook silver reels. Change only the topic/hook family where practical.
rules.verification: ops/profit-system/buffer-metrics/2026-07-27.json; initial mature YouTube sample: decision/monetary posts 85, 54, and 25 views versus industrial/outlook posts 0 and 0 views.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or revise if three matched samples fail to improve median D+3 views per hour by 15%, or if downstream clicks/qualified demand regress.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Prevent misleading financial visuals and broken citations from eroding reader trust, search value, qualified demand, and conversion.
rules.leadingMetric: numeric visual and malformed-source defects blocked before posts.json registration
rules.laggingMetric: qualified Fused Reserve leads, conversions, and attributed gross profit from corrected silver content
guardrails: Allow a clean numeric-visual skip when another valid custom graphic explains the article.
Do not force unrelated numbers into a bar chart to satisfy a visual quota.
Do not weaken financial accuracy, source provenance, or authoritative live verification.
rules.control: Require schema v2 metric, unit, period, verbatim evidence, named HTTPS source, and type-specific semantic validation; exclude generated HTML as evidence and block malformed source markup.
rules.verification: public/blog/scripts/build-chart-inject.test.mjs mixed-stat, evidence, before/after, and stat-card regression cases; qa-local.mjs visual and href gates
rules.rollbackCondition: Narrow only if more than 5% of manually reviewed valid visuals are false positives; never remove provenance, valid-link, or no-self-validation controls.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: A controlled increase from three to six daily posts per channel should burn down release-ready backlog and expand qualified reach without sacrificing publishing reliability or content quality.
rules.leadingMetric: Confirmed sent posts per channel per Pacific day, release-ready backlog age/count, Buffer error and duplicate rates, and matched D+1/D+3/D+7 clicks, watch duration, and engagement
rules.laggingMetric: Qualified site visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and attributed gross profit
guardrails: Keep three confirmed posts per channel as the hard daily floor.
Do not weaken release QA, media verification, the seven-day cooldown, or authoritative Buffer readback.
Keep the organization limit of 10 and one safety slot.
Prefer new and unsent approved work before rotated backlog.
rules.control: Through 2026-08-12, target six posts per channel at 01:00, 05:00, 09:00, 13:00, 17:00, and 21:00 Pacific. Refill every four hours, count scheduled/sending/sent posts for the operating date, schedule strictly after the latest active dueAt, preserve one of ten slots, and never roll a current-day deficit into tomorrow.
rules.verification: tests/buffer-daily-targets.test.mjs; tests/buffer-repost-policy.test.mjs; Buffer queue validation and API create/readback
rules.rollbackCondition: Revert to three per channel on a quality escape, active duplicate, recurrent platform error, baseline-floor miss caused by expedited capacity, or at least 25% lower matched median engagement.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Prevent unavailable business evidence from being mistaken for a verified zero, preserving correct profit prioritization and preventing unsupported attribution decisions.
rules.leadingMetric: Daily audit reports with no revenue or gross-profit events display unavailable rather than a dollar amount.
rules.laggingMetric: Attributed revenue, gross profit, qualified leads, and conversions once authoritative evidence becomes available.
guardrails: Keep verified zero-value business evidence distinct from unavailable evidence when such an authoritative source is integrated.
Do not infer revenue, gross profit, leads, conversions, or attribution from operational rewards or Buffer metrics.
Do not weaken audit, release-QA, or authoritative-readback gates.
rules.control: Render unavailable in the daily audit when no attributable revenue or gross-profit events exist, with a regression test covering both unavailable and recorded-evidence cases.
rules.verification: tests/profit-sop-audit.test.mjs unavailable revenue and gross-profit evidence case.
rules.rollbackCondition: Revise only after an authoritative zero-revenue source is integrated and the report can distinguish confirmed zero from unavailable evidence without ambiguity.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Recovering transient metric reads preserves matched D+1, D+3, and D+7 evidence needed to choose distribution work without mistaking missing evidence for weak performance.
rules.leadingMetric: Successful same-date Buffer metric snapshots after a transient API failure, with no snapshot age-bucket or platform mismatch.
rules.laggingMetric: Qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit attributed only when authoritative evidence becomes available.
guardrails: Never substitute a prior snapshot for the requested operating date or treat an unavailable snapshot as zero.
Do not retry authentication, validation, or other non-transient Buffer failures.
Do not weaken Buffer API readback or matched D+1, D+3, and D+7 comparison rules.
rules.control: Retry each transient Buffer GraphQL request at most three times, then fail closed and report the requested-date snapshot as unavailable.
rules.verification: tests/buffer-performance-snapshot.test.mjs transient retry and non-transient failure cases.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire if three comparable snapshot runs show no recovery after transient failures, or if retries cause duplicate requests, rate-limit escalation, or incorrect same-date evidence.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Prevent truncated or mismatched X video assets from creating failed distribution, rework, and lost qualified demand.
rules.leadingMetric: X queue candidates rejected before Buffer create when the platform cutdown is shorter than its source-relative minimum or hosted bytes differ from the verified local copy.
rules.laggingMetric: Confirmed X video delivery followed by qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit when authoritative attribution is available.
guardrails: Keep Buffer get_post video-asset readback and post-due reconciliation mandatory.
Do not treat a decodable MP4, a successful create response, or matching MIME type as proof of a complete video asset.
Do not infer unavailable Buffer, lead, conversion, revenue, or gross-profit evidence as zero.
rules.control: Reject X platform copies below min(source duration, 135 seconds) minus one second, reject hosted/local byte-length mismatches during planning, and retain the existing Buffer video-asset readback before logging success.
rules.verification: tests/buffer-capacity.test.mjs rejects the observed 182.485-second to 0.333-second truncation and accepts the 135-second target; ops/profit-system/evolution/feedback/2026-08-07-buffer-x-truncated-media.json records the corrected Buffer readback.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or narrow after three comparable X media-preparation runs if the control produces a false positive, blocks a valid verified asset, or fails to prevent another source-relative truncation or byte-parity mismatch.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Detecting a daily channel-floor deficit while there is still time to prepare eligible, reviewed work prevents missed distribution opportunities and the resulting loss of qualified demand.
rules.leadingMetric: Buffer status checkpoints that report per-channel operating-date deficits and release-QA-not-ready blockers at least four hours before the final daily slot.
rules.laggingMetric: Confirmed sent posts per channel, then attributable qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit.
guardrails: Do not mark a reel ready, schedule it, or create a Buffer post without the existing manual caption review, release QA, media verification, and Buffer readback.
Treat an empty or unavailable queue as a checkpoint failure, never as a completed distribution day.
Do not infer Buffer, lead, conversion, revenue, or gross-profit evidence as zero.
rules.control: For the next three comparable operating days, capture Buffer status at least four hours before the final daily slot. Status must emit an on-time or late readiness checkpoint. When any channel is below its three-post floor, record its deficit and each release-QA-not-ready blocker in the dated audit before the final slot; any release work remains pending human caption review and is never auto-approved.
rules.verification: npm run social:buffer:live -- status reports dated channel deficits, readiness-checkpoint timing, and reconciled scheduled-log changes; tests/buffer-daily-targets.test.mjs covers operating-date floor calculation and the four-hour cutoff. On 2026-08-11, the explicit six-post target readback found a fifteen-post total deficit and a late checkpoint, so the experiment remains unproven.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or revise after three comparable operating days if the checkpoint fails to expose a floor deficit at least four hours before the final slot, creates a false-ready claim, or coincides with a release-QA, media, duplicate, or platform-compliance regression.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: A nonzero exit when a late checkpoint still has a channel-floor deficit makes the distribution shortfall actionable for the owner without creating unreviewed posts or concealing the loss of qualified-demand opportunities.
rules.leadingMetric: On-time Buffer floor checks completed with --require-on-time-floor and zero late-deficit false successes.
rules.laggingMetric: Confirmed sent posts per channel, then attributable qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit.
guardrails: Do not create, edit, or approve Buffer posts from the checkpoint command.
Keep manual caption review, release QA, media verification, capacity, and authoritative Buffer readback mandatory.
Do not treat unavailable lead, conversion, revenue, or gross-profit evidence as zero.
rules.control: For the next three comparable operating days, invoke Buffer status with --require-on-time-floor at least four hours before the final slot. It must exit nonzero only when the current operating date has both a late checkpoint and one or more channel deficits; record the channel list and blockers before any separately approved recovery work.
rules.verification: tests/buffer-daily-targets.test.mjs covers late-deficit failure and on-time pass; buffer-live status emits dailyFloorEnforcement before an enforced failure.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or narrow after three comparable operating days if it produces a false failure, masks the exact deficit, or coincides with a release-QA, duplicate, platform-compliance, or unauthorized-publishing regression.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Prevent generic formula-unit labels from incorrectly blocking otherwise eligible, accurate content while retaining the gate that rejects unsupported third-party statistical attributions.
rules.leadingMetric: Formula-unit QA false positives and source-attribution blocks per comparable silver article.
rules.laggingMetric: Qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit from released articles when authoritative attribution is available.
guardrails: Continue to block unsupported named sources and numerical claims.
Do not bypass research provenance, financial-accuracy, editorial, or release-QA gates.
Do not publish or approve content from this control.
rules.control: Treat generic formula-unit parentheticals such as Dollars, Percent, Ounces, Grams, and Kilograms as units rather than source names in the sourced-stat validator; preserve detection of named sources such as Statista.
rules.verification: tests/sourced-stats.test.mjs verifies the Dollars replay is accepted and an unsupported Statista attribution remains blocked; npm run profit:test passes.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or narrow after three comparable article replays if a generic unit exemption permits an unsupported named-source attribution or produces any financial-accuracy, provenance, editorial, or release-QA regression.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Make release-QA blockers visible in the dated profit audit so unreleased reels cannot be mistaken for eligible distribution inventory, preserving qualified-demand opportunities without bypassing human review.
rules.leadingMetric: Dated audits that enumerate each registered queue reel blocked by missing release QA or manual caption review.
rules.laggingMetric: Confirmed sent posts per channel, then attributable qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit.
guardrails: Do not mark a reel ready, schedule it, or create a Buffer post from the audit checkpoint.
Keep manual caption review, release QA, media verification, capacity, and authoritative Buffer readback mandatory.
Do not infer unavailable Buffer, lead, conversion, revenue, or gross-profit evidence as zero.
rules.control: For every dated blog queue, derive reel-release readiness from release-qa.json for registered slugs and report missing QA, manual-caption-review-pending, and other not-ready blockers by slug in profit:audit.
rules.verification: tests/profit-sop-audit.test.mjs reports manual-review, ready, and missing-release-QA cases; focused test passed on 2026-08-15.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or narrow after three comparable operating days if the checkpoint omits a real registered-reel blocker, creates a false-ready claim, or coincides with a release-QA, duplicate, platform-compliance, or unauthorized-publishing regression.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Accurate Pacific-day sent counts prevent false floor deficits, avoid wasted recovery effort, and keep distribution decisions tied to authoritative delivery evidence.
rules.leadingMetric: Buffer status count matches same-date Buffer metric snapshot per channel after cursor pagination, with zero false zero-send reports.
rules.laggingMetric: Confirmed sent posts per channel, followed by attributable qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit when authoritative evidence is available.
guardrails: Do not create, edit, approve, or publish Buffer posts from the status command.
Keep manual caption review, release QA, media verification, capacity, duplicate controls, and authoritative Buffer readback mandatory.
Do not treat unavailable lead, conversion, revenue, or gross-profit evidence as zero.
rules.control: Paginate Buffer sent-post history until pageInfo.hasNextPage is false before calculating daily channel targets or reconciling local scheduled logs.
rules.verification: tests/buffer-post-pagination.test.mjs exercises a multi-page sent history; on 2026-08-17 live Buffer readback changed the erroneous zero sends per channel to one sent per channel, matching the same-date metric snapshot.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or revise after three comparable status checks if cursor pagination omits a current sent post, duplicates a post in counts, increases Buffer API errors or rate limits, or causes any false delivery claim.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Giving readers direct, accessible paths to the already published YouTube, X, and Instagram versions of a reel can increase qualified video engagement, follows, return visits, and future conversion opportunities.
rules.leadingMetric: Published blog articles with authoritative social links, platform clickthroughs, and video plays where the platform reports them.
rules.laggingMetric: Qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit attributed only when authoritative evidence is available.
guardrails: Only show a platform URL after Buffer readback confirms the post is sent and provides its external link.
Do not invent URLs, treat scheduled posts as live, or bypass manual caption review and release QA.
Keep visible text links as a fallback when a platform widget is unavailable or blocked.
rules.control: After Buffer status reconciles sent-post logs, synchronize each verified external URL into the matching blog article. Embed YouTube using its privacy enhanced player, use the official X widget for public posts, and retain a resilient Instagram Reel link.
rules.verification: npm run social:blog-video-links; 20 historical sent-post panels synchronized on 2026-08-18, including 16 complete YouTube, X, and Instagram sets.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or revise after three comparable review cycles if links are mismatched, widgets meaningfully degrade performance or accessibility, platform compliance changes, or engagement does not improve without a downstream benefit.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Failing known-bad generated HTML, social copy, and reel timing before JPG rendering reduces avoidable asset work and preserves time for eligible content without weakening publication gates.
rules.baseline: Nine blog-quality-gate-blocked occurrences in the 30-day repeat window; two blocked queue slugs on 2026-08-19 were detected after the asset stage.
rules.comparisonWindow: Three comparable blog-build runs after 2026-08-19, evaluated only when the preflight has the required generated artifacts.
rules.leadingMetric: Quality blocks discovered after JPG rendering, preflight false blocks, and asset-render attempts for preflight-failed slugs.
rules.laggingMetric: Quality-blocked posts per comparable operating day, then qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit when authoritative attribution is available.
guardrails: Do not register, publish, approve, recover, or edit a post from the preflight control.
Keep the final deterministic QA, brain QA, research provenance, financial accuracy, editorial, release QA, and human review gates mandatory.
Do not treat unavailable lead, conversion, revenue, or gross-profit evidence as zero.
rules.control: Run qa-local after HTML, reel, and social generation but before JPG asset rendering. On failure, write qa-preflight.json, mark qa-preflight-fail, and stop the post without asset rendering; retain the existing final QA after assets.
rules.verification: tests/build-post-preflight.test.mjs verifies preflight ordering and retention of final QA; bash -n validates the orchestrator syntax; npm run profit:test is required before review.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or narrow after three comparable builds if the preflight creates a false block, fails to prevent post-asset discovery of a covered defect, prevents asset rendering for a valid post, or coincides with any provenance, financial-accuracy, editorial, release-QA, duplicate, or unauthorized-publishing regression.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Recording every dated quality block in the profit ledger prevents incomplete content production from being scored as a profitable operating day, making repeated defects visible for targeted prevention before they suppress qualified demand.
rules.leadingMetric: Each quality-blocked queue slug produces exactly one same-date missed-checkpoint event, with zero duplicate events across audit reruns.
rules.laggingMetric: Quality-blocked posts per comparable operating day, followed by qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit when authoritative attribution is available.
guardrails: Do not publish, approve, recover, or alter blocked content from the audit command.
Keep all editorial, research provenance, financial accuracy, release QA, and human review gates mandatory.
Do not infer unavailable lead, conversion, revenue, or gross-profit evidence as zero.
rules.control: On profit:audit, derive blocked queue slugs from the dated .workflow-blocked checkpoint and append one idempotent missed-checkpoint event using the stable blog-quality-gate-blocked fingerprint before scoring the report.
rules.verification: tests/profit-sop-audit.test.mjs verifies the blocked slug, stable fingerprint, and no-duplicate rerun behavior; npm run profit:test passes.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or narrow after three comparable audit runs if the checkpoint records a false quality block, duplicates an event, omits an archived blocked queue slug, or causes any unauthorized content action.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Retaining a valid same-date Buffer snapshot after a later transient refresh failure preserves matched performance evidence, prevents false missed-checkpoint penalties, and avoids unnecessary recovery work.
rules.baseline: On 2026-08-25, a valid 174-post Buffer snapshot existed, but a later fetch failure caused the audit to classify the day as unavailable and append a repeat missed-checkpoint penalty.
rules.comparisonWindow: Three comparable operating dates with both a valid same-date Buffer API snapshot and a later unavailable refresh checkpoint, evaluated against correct retained evidence and no false ledger penalty.
rules.leadingMetric: Audit runs classify valid same-date snapshots as available_with_refresh_failure, retain matched D+1/D+3/D+7 comparisons, and append zero false buffer-metrics-api-fetch-unavailable penalties.
rules.laggingMetric: More reliable evidence-based distribution decisions, then qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit when authoritative attribution is available.
guardrails: Do not substitute a prior-date snapshot, invent missing Buffer values, or suppress a true same-date collection failure.
Keep failed refresh checkpoints visible without exposing Buffer credentials or raw request headers.
Do not create, edit, approve, or publish Buffer posts from snapshot or audit commands.
rules.control: During profit:audit, accept only a structurally valid same-date Buffer API snapshot with a posts array as available evidence. If a later unavailable checkpoint also exists, report available_with_refresh_failure and retain the failure checkpoint for observation; append the missed-checkpoint event only when no usable same-date snapshot exists.
rules.verification: Focused profit audit and Buffer snapshot tests passed on 2026-08-25. The corrected audit retains the 2026-08-25 snapshot and excludes the superseded false missed-checkpoint event from score and repeat counts.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or revise after three comparable dates if the precedence check accepts a malformed or wrong-date snapshot, masks a true unavailable collection, creates a duplicate ledger event, or changes Buffer publishing behavior.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: A dated, idempotent unavailable checkpoint prevents failed Buffer collection from silently removing matched leading-indicator evidence, so distribution decisions remain evidence-bound and manual recovery work is reduced.
rules.baseline: Six Buffer metric snapshot failures are recorded in the 30-day repeat window; before this control, the audit required a separate manual ledger entry after a failed snapshot.
rules.comparisonWindow: Three comparable same-date snapshot failures or recoveries after 2026-08-20, compared only by the presence of one dated unavailable checkpoint and one corresponding ledger event.
rules.leadingMetric: Failed Buffer snapshots with exactly one dated unavailable checkpoint and exactly one same-date missed-checkpoint event, with zero duplicate events across audit reruns.
rules.laggingMetric: Restored matched D+1, D+3, and D+7 leading-indicator availability, then qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit when authoritative evidence is available.
guardrails: Do not expose Buffer access tokens, raw request headers, or sensitive API response details in a checkpoint or report.
Do not treat an unavailable checkpoint as zero performance or substitute a prior-date snapshot.
Do not create, edit, approve, or publish Buffer posts from snapshot or audit commands.
rules.control: On a failed same-date Buffer metric snapshot, write a dated unavailable checkpoint with no performance values. During profit:audit, read that checkpoint and append the stable missed-checkpoint event only when it is absent for the operating date.
rules.verification: Focused snapshot and audit tests passed on 2026-08-20. Three comparable failed snapshots on 2026-08-20, 2026-08-21, and 2026-08-22 each wrote one dated unavailable checkpoint and produced one same-date ledger event without metric values; the 2026-08-22 audit rerun confirmed idempotency.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or revise after three comparable runs if the control writes a false unavailable checkpoint, duplicates a ledger event, omits a real failed snapshot, exposes sensitive information, or changes Buffer publishing behavior.
